title: Protocol to assess substrate dephosphorylation by serine/threonine phosphoprotein phosphatases in vitro
protocol: Aliquot 0.1–0.5 μg of GST-protein loaded Sepharose beads.
Equilibrate the aliquoted beads with 100 μL of 1× KAS buffer.
Centrifuge at 775 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C and aspirate the buffer.
Repeat wash with 1× KAS buffer, centrifuge at 775 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C, and aspirate again.
Add 10 μL of 1× KAS + 1.5 mM ATP + 1 unit of Kinase to the beads.
Shake at 37°C for 1 hour using a modified vortex genie with shake level 3.
Centrifuge at 775 × g for 3 minutes at 20–24°C and aspirate buffer.
Equilibrate GST-protein loaded Sepharose beads for dephosphorylation with 1 mL of Complete DIP buffer.
Repeat centrifugation and equilibration step with another 1 mL of complete DIP buffer.
Prepare an appropriate volume of Master mix consisting of 5 μL phosphatase and 10 μL Complete DIP buffer per sample.
Add the 15 μL phosphatase-DIP master mix to the phosphorylated substrate.
Incubate at 37°C for the given timepoints (e.g., 0.25, 0.5, 1, and 2 h).
Terminate the reactions with LSB followed by heating to 65°C.
Resolve proteins using SDS-PAGE (8%–10%, depending on the size of the GST-fused substrates).
Stain the gel with Coomassie Blue for substrates which shift migration upon phosphorylation.
Perform a western blot using phosphospecific antibodies to detect phosphorylation/dephosphorylation of substrates if needed.
Load purified GST-p107-R1-R2 on glutathione Sepharose beads.
Phosphorylate the loaded beads with Cyclin B/CDK1 in the presence of ATP for 1 hour at 37°C.
Wash the phosphorylated beads with DIP buffer.
Dephosphorylate the washed beads with PP2A/Flag-B55α holoenzyme for indicated times.
Resolve the beads by SDS/PAGE and perform western blot analysis using anti-P-SP CDK substrate antibody.
Stain the PVDF membrane with Coomassie Blue after antibody detection.
Load glutathione beads with GST or GST-p107-R1-R2 substrates.
Incubate the loaded beads with 293T lysates.
Wash the incubated beads and resolve by SDS/PAGE.
Perform western blot analysis using anti-B55α antibodies.
Stain the PVDF membrane with Coomassie Blue after antibody detection.
Centrifuge aliquoted normalized GST-fused substrate loaded Sepharose beads at 775 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate buffer from centrifuged beads.
Repeat wash with Complete DIP buffer.
Repeat centrifugation and aspiration.
Prepare cell lysate from any cell lines expressing endogenous PP2A/B55α holoenzymes using 200–400 μg of lysate (∼1 μg/μL).
Alternatively, use 5 μL purified PP2A/B55α holoenzyme with Complete DIP buffer (minimum volume of 250 μL) per sample.
Collect sample inputs (5%–10%) for future SDS-PAGE applications.
Add washed GST-protein beads (0.2–0.5 μg) to the lysates or purified PP2A/B55α and incubate at RT or 4°C on a rotator (1 h, this step can also be done overnight).
Collect sample supernatants (5%–10%) for future SDS-PAGE applications.
Wash protein-bound, GST-substrate loaded Sepharose beads with 1 mL of Complete DIP buffer.
Centrifuge at 775 × g for 3 min at 4°C and aspirate buffer.
Repeat wash step and aspiration two additional times.
Denature on-bead complexes using 2× LSB and heating to 65°C.
Resolve proteins using SDS-PAGE followed by western blot analysis to detect B55α, PP2A/A, and PP2A/C binding to the GST-fused substrate.
Stain the membrane with Coomassie Blue to visualize the GST-fused substrates.
Perform a western blot with anti-GST antibodies to visualize the GST-fused proteins.
Procure synthetic peptides derived from your protein of interest.
Solubilize and dialyze peptides according to manufacturer specifications.
Pre-incubate purified PP2A/B55α holoenzyme (5 μL) with 30–300 μM of synthetic peptide at 37°C for 30 min in a final volume of 200 μL in Complete DIP buffer.
Add normalized purified GST-fused substrate to the pre-incubated holoenzyme for 3–16 h at 4°C using a rotator.
Collect sample supernatants (5%–10%) for future SDS-PAGE applications.
Wash GST-protein loaded Sepharose beads with 1 mL of Complete DIP buffer.
Centrifuge at 775 × g for 3 min at 4°C and aspirate the buffer.
Repeat wash steps four additional times.
Denature proteins with 2× LSB and heat to 65°C.
Detect proteins using SDS-PAGE followed by western blot analysis.
